mainEntity.name: What is APAC token launch PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: APAC token launch PR is the coordinated management of press, KOL and community coverage across Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia around a token generation event or major protocol announcement. It is for Web3 founders whose token has real utility or community demand in at least one of those three markets and who want regional media coverage to fire in the same news cycle as their global launch, not days later via a translated press release. Shilika Jain covers six APAC markets for $5K–$12K/month on retainer or $15K–$40K as a standalone launch sprint.

mainEntity.name: How much does APAC token launch PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standalone APAC TGE launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks, covering window mapping, localised materials, KOL pre-briefs and post-TGE follow-through. An ongoing fractional retainer that includes APAC as part of a broader PR programme runs $5K–$12K/month. Full agencies charge $15K–$45K/month for comparable scope. Regional KOLs add separately: nano-tier $200–$1.5K, micro $500–$5K, mid $10K–$30K per activation.

mainEntity.name: Which APAC outlets can you actually get placements in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Korea: BloomingBit, TokenPost, Decenter, CoinDesk Korea. Japan: CoinPost, CryptoTimes JP, Coin Telegraph Japan. SEA: CoinDesk Singapore, e27, Forkast, Tech in Asia. For projects with a strong enough angle: Nikkei Asia, The Korea Economic Daily, South China Morning Post (tech desk). Placement depends on a real news hook. Wire blasts to these desks are filtered out immediately.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance do you need to start for a TGE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Eight weeks is the minimum for a coordinated APAC campaign. That window covers: finalising the narrative, building the regional journalist map, translating materials, briefing KOLs under NDA and setting the embargo schedule. Starting at four weeks is possible but compresses the KOL pre-brief window and limits which tier-1 editors will take an exclusive.
